source.author: ov
source.text: Haemoniae matres pro gnatis dona receptis grandaevique ferunt patres congestaque flamma tura liquefaciunt, inductaque cornibus aurum victima vota cadit.
source.text_original: Haemoniae matres pro gnatis dona receptis / grandaevique ferunt patres congestaque flamma / tura liquefaciunt, inductaque cornibus aurum / victima vota cadit.
source.text_english: The mothers of Haemonia and the aged fathers bring gifts for their sons who have been restored, and they melt the piled-up incense in the flame; and the victim, its horns overlaid with gold, falls in fulfillment of their vows.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: vestris egomet tune vellera templis illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_original: vestris egomet tune vellera templis / illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni / colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_english: Shall I myself then give those fleeces to your temples? Their father shall give his neck to the gilded fire, and snowy flocks shall surround the altars.
